description: Change a drop's visibility (private = link-only + noindex, public = indexable), its expiration, or remove the "Hosted on Dropyour" badge (badgeHidden — Pro account token required), or its private name (name — empty string clears it), or email notifications to its owner and collaborators on each NEW record of an app with a server (notifications: on/off, each time / hourly / daily digest, link only, which collections, which fields are sensitive and never emailed). Switching to public triggers a stricter content re-scan and may be rejected. With an account token, owned drops need no managementToken.

badgeHidden.description: Remove the Dropyour badge — requires a Pro account token

expiresInSeconds.description: Expiration in seconds (1h..2592000) or "default" (your tier's default)

name.description: A private name for this drop (only you see it). Empty string clears it.

notifications.description: Email notifications on new records (owner and collaborators only ; requires the app to belong to an account)

actif.description: Turn email notifications on or off

champsSensibles.description: Field names never put in the email (in addition to the ones detected by name : passwords, payment, identity, health, attachments)

collections.description: Collections to watch ; empty or absent = all

frequence.description: chaque = each new record (grouped, at most one email per 5 minutes) ; heure = hourly digest ; jour = daily digest around 7-8 am Paris

lienSeulement.description: true = no record content in the email, only the count and a link

publishAt.description: Scheduled go-live (ISO datetime) — the drop returns 404 until then (future, before expiration). Empty string = publish now.

tags.description: Private tags — replaces all tags. Empty array clears them.

name: dropyour_update_settings
title: Change a drop's settings
